<infobox theme="starship">
	<image source="image"></image>
    <title source="name"></title>
    <navigation name="mobile-eras"><center>{{Top-mobile}}</center></navigation>
    <group collapse="open">
    	<header>Production information</header>
        <data source="designer"><label>Designer</label></data>	
        <data source="manufacturer"><label>Manufacturer</label></data>
        <data source="line"><label>Line</label></data>	
        <data source="model"><label>Model</label></data>	
        <data source="type"><label>Type</label></data>	
        <data source="cost"><label>Cost</label></data>	
        <data source="modifier"><label>Modifier</label></data>
    </group>
    <group collapse="open">
    	<header>Technical specifications</header>
        <data source="sysmods"><label>Modified systems</label></data>	
        <data source="length"><label>Length</label></data>	
        <data source="width"><label>Width</label></data>	
        <data source="height"><label>Height</label></data>	
        <data source="diameter"><label>Diameter</label></data>	
        <data source="mass"><label>Mass</label></data>	
        <data source="max accel"><label>Maximum acceleration</label></data>        
        <data source="mglt"><label>Megalight per hour</label></data>	
        <data source="max speed"><label>Maximum speed (atmosphere)</label></data>	
        <data source="maneuverability"><label>Maneuverability rating</label></data>	
        <data source="engine"><label>Engine unit(s)</label></data>	
        <data source="hyperdrive"><label>Hyperdrive rating</label></data>	
        <data source="hdrange"><label>Hyperdrive range</label></data>
        <data source="hdsystem"><label>Hyperdrive system</label></data>	
        <data source="poweroutput"><label>Power output</label></data>	
        <data source="power"><label>Power plant</label></data>	
        <data source="shield gen"><label>Shielding</label></data>	
        <data source="hull"><label>Hull</label></data>	
        <data source="sensor"><label>Sensor systems</label></data>
        <data source="target"><label>Targeting systems</label></data>	
        <data source="navigation"><label>Navigation system</label></data>	
        <data source="avionics"><label>Avionics</label></data>	
        <data source="maincomp"><label>Main computer</label></data>	
        <data source="countermeasures"><label>Counter<wbr />measures</label></data>	
        <data source="armament"><label>Armament</label></data>        	
        <data source="complement"><label>Complement</label></data>	
        <data source="bays"><label>Docking bays</label></data>	
        <data source="escapepods"><label>Escape craft</label></data>	
        <data source="crew"><label>Crew</label></data>
        <data source="skeleton"><label>Minimum crew</label></data>	
        <data source="passengers"><label>Passengers</label></data>	
        <data source="capacity"><label>Cargo capacity</label></data>
        <data source="cargohandling"><label>Cargo handling systems</label></data>	
        <data source="consumables"><label>Consumables</label></data>	
        <data source="lifesupport"><label>Life support</label></data>	
        <data source="communications"><label>Communication systems</label></data>	
        <data source="othersystems"><label>Other systems</label></data>
    </group>
    <group collapse="open">
    	<header>Location information</header>
        <data source="region"><label>Region</label><format>{{#if:{{{is_mobile|}}}||{{{region|}}}}}</format></data>
        <data source="sector"><label>Sector</label><format>{{#if:{{{is_mobile|}}}||{{#ifeq:{{lc:{{{sector|}}}}}|none||{{#ifeq:{{lc:{{{sector|}}}}}|n/a||{{{sector|}}}}}}}}}</format></data>
        <data source="system"><label>System</label><format>{{#if:{{{is_mobile|}}}||{{#ifeq:{{lc:{{{system}}}}}|none||{{{system|}}}}}}}</format></data>
        <data source="coordinates"><label>Grid square</label><format>{{#ifeq:{{lc:{{{coordinates|}}}}}|canon-only||{{#if:{{{is_mobile|}}}||{{#ifeq:{{lc:{{{coordinates}}}}}|n/a||{{{coordinates|}}}}}}}}}</format></data>
        <data source="xyz"><label>XYZ coordinates</label><format>{{#if:{{{is_mobile|}}}||{{{xyz|}}}}}</format></data>
        <data source="orbited"><label>Orbit(s)</label><format>{{#if:{{{is_mobile|}}}||{{{orbited|}}}}}</format></data>
        <data source="distance"><label>Orbital distance</label><format>{{#if:{{{is_mobile|}}}||{{{distance|}}}}}</format></data>
        <data source="routes"><label>Trade routes</label></data>
    </group>
    <group collapse="open">
    	<header>Usage</header>
        <data source="role"><label>Role(s)</label></data>	
        <data source="affiliation"><label>Affiliation</label></data>
        <data source="constructed"><label>Constructed</label></data>	
        <data source="destroyed"><label>Destroyed</label></data>	
        <data source="retired"><label>Retired</label></data>	
        <data source="battles"><label>Present for battles/events</label></data>
        <data source="owners"><label>Owner(s)</label></data>
        <data source="namedcrew"><label>Crewmembers</label></data>
        <data source="captains"><label>Commander(s)</label></data>	
        <data source="registry"><label>Registry</label></data>	
        <data source="aliases"><label>Aliases</label></data>	
        <data source="population"><label>Population</label></data>	
        <data source="interest"><label>Points of interest</label></data>	
        <data source="services"><label>Services</label></data>	
        <data source="sectors"><label>Sectors/areas</label></data>	
        <data source="modules"><label>Modules</label></data>	
    </group>
	<navigation><small>{{PlainLink|//starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Template:SpaceStation|name=<nowiki>[</nowiki>Source<nowiki>]</nowiki>}}</small></navigation>
</infobox>{{PreloadCat}}<!-- TEMPLATE ENDS HERE.

==Usage==
This is an infobox for technical and usage information on space stations. Note that the Location information parameters should not be filled in for any space station shown to be mobile.

Cut and paste the following code into your article, then put the relevant specifications after the "=" signs.
<pre class="wrap"><nowiki>{{Top}}
